entities.description: Array of sub job objects that were successfully created or updated during the sync. Each object conforms to the sub_job schema.

errors.description: Array of error objects for sub jobs that failed to sync. Each object contains the sub job id, and an errors map keyed by attribute name listing validation messages.

id.description: Procore integer ID of the sub job to update. Use the id field from GET /rest/v1.0/sub_jobs. Omit to create a new sub job during sync.

name.description: Display name for the sub job (e.g. "Floor 2", "Phase 1 - Foundation").

code.description: Short alphanumeric code for the sub job, unique within the project.

origin_id.description: Third-party unique identifier from an ERP or external integration used to match this sub job to an external record.

origin_data.description: Arbitrary JSON string containing additional third-party data from an external integration.
